# Sakura Labs (sakuralabs.in)
> Full-Service Digital Agency: High-Performance Web Development, Mobile Apps, Ads, and Growth Marketing.

## About Sakura Labs
Sakura Labs is a modern digital agency and technology studio based in India, operating globally. We craft next-generation web applications, native & cross-platform mobile apps, ROI-driven performance marketing campaigns, and cutting-edge UI/UX brand experiences.

- Website: https://sakuralabs.in
- Email: sakuralabs.dev@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 87142 44119
- Location: Malappuram, Kerala, India (Serving Global Clients)

## Core Services
1. **Web Development**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, high-performance web applications, headless commerce, landing pages, custom web systems with 99+ Lighthouse performance scores.
2. **App Development**: Native and cross-platform iOS & Android mobile applications built with React Native and modern mobile stacks.
3. **Performance Ads**: High-ROI Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns engineered for conversion, customer acquisition, and scale.
4. **Digital Marketing & SEO**: Full-funnel digital marketing, technical search engine optimization, content strategy, brand positioning, and analytics.
5. **Brand & UI/UX Design**: Premium interactive design systems, product design, brand identity, and fluid motion design.
